origin.name: Genesis
origin.desc: The starting point of your skill tree.

packRat.name: Pack Rat
packRat.desc: +1 slot to your Gear, Consumables and Materials tabs.

bottomlessPack.name: Bottomless Pack
bottomlessPack.desc: +4 slots to your Gear, Consumables and Materials tabs.

weaknesses.name: Weaknesses
weaknesses.desc: Allows you to take advantage of enemy weaknesses.

overkill.name: Splash
overkill.desc: 10% of damage done is also done to other enemies

fireMastery.name: Fire Mastery
fireMastery.desc: Hits on a fire weakness deal more damage: +0.1 to the fire weakness multiplier. Needs the Weaknesses skill.

waterMastery.name: Water Mastery
waterMastery.desc: Hits on a water weakness deal more damage: +0.1 to the water weakness multiplier. Needs the Weaknesses skill.

airMastery.name: Air Mastery
airMastery.desc: Hits on an air weakness deal more damage: +0.1 to the air weakness multiplier. Needs the Weaknesses skill.

earthMastery.name: Earth Mastery
earthMastery.desc: Hits on an earth weakness deal more damage: +0.1 to the earth weakness multiplier. Needs the Weaknesses skill.

fireStrikeCooldown.name: Kindling
fireStrikeCooldown.desc: Fire Strike's cooldown is 5 seconds shorter per level.

tidalLashCooldown.name: Undertow
tidalLashCooldown.desc: Tidal Lash's cooldown is 5 seconds shorter per level.

galeCutCooldown.name: Tailwind
galeCutCooldown.desc: Gale Cut's cooldown is 3 seconds shorter per level.

stoneSpikeMana.name: Bedrock
stoneSpikeMana.desc: Stone Spike costs 1 less mana per level.

maxMana.name: Max Mana
maxMana.desc: Increases max mana by 1. Opens once you know any strike spell (Fire Strike, Tidal Lash, Gale Cut or Stone Spike).

magicDamage.name: Magic Damage
magicDamage.desc: Increases damage of your magic spells by 1.

spellCooldown.name: Spell Cooldown
spellCooldown.desc: Reduces your spell cooldowns by 2 seconds.

shinyHunter.name: Shiny Hunter
shinyHunter.desc: Enemies have a 1% chance to be shiny, granting 10x drops, 5x XP, and 10x gold.

autoEat.name: Hearty Appetite
autoEat.desc: Automatically eats your last food again when the food slot unlocks.
